_note: Natural / home-care steps for the no-medicine plan. Shown only for mild cases. They support recovery; they do not cure infections.

remedies.name: Steam inhalation
remedies.how: Breathe steam from a bowl of hot water (towel over head) for 5-10 minutes. Keep a safe distance to avoid burns.

remedies.name: Warm salt-water gargle
remedies.how: Half a teaspoon of salt in a glass of warm water; gargle 3-4 times a day.

remedies.name: Ginger-honey warm drink
remedies.how: Boil a few slices of ginger in water, cool slightly and add 1 teaspoon honey.

remedies.name: Haldi (turmeric) milk
remedies.how: Half a teaspoon turmeric in a cup of warm milk at bedtime.

remedies.name: Tulsi (holy basil) tea
remedies.how: Boil 5-6 tulsi leaves in a cup of water for 5 minutes; sip warm.

remedies.name: Homemade ORS
remedies.how: 1 litre clean boiled-and-cooled water + 6 level teaspoons sugar + half level teaspoon salt. Sip through the day; make fresh daily.

remedies.name: Coconut water
remedies.how: 1-2 glasses a day for fluids and potassium.

remedies.name: Nimbu pani with a pinch of salt
remedies.how: Lemon juice in a glass of water with a pinch of salt and sugar; sip in hot weather.

remedies.name: Banana and curd
remedies.how: A ripe banana and a bowl of curd help settle loose motions and restore gut bacteria.

remedies.name: Jeera (cumin) water
remedies.how: Boil 1 teaspoon cumin seeds in a glass of water; sip warm after meals.

remedies.name: Saunf (fennel seeds) after meals
remedies.how: Chew half a teaspoon of fennel seeds after lunch and dinner.

remedies.name: Half cup cold milk
remedies.how: Sip half a cup of cold milk when heartburn starts (if it suits you).

remedies.name: Soaked anjeer (figs) or prunes
remedies.how: Soak 2 figs or 3 prunes overnight; eat in the morning with the water.

remedies.name: Isabgol husk in warm water
remedies.how: 1-2 teaspoons isabgol in a glass of warm water or milk at bedtime, with extra water during the day.

remedies.name: 2 glasses warm water on waking
remedies.how: Drink 2 glasses of lukewarm water right after waking, then a short walk.

remedies.name: Cold compress
remedies.how: Wrap ice in a cloth and hold on the forehead or neck for 15 minutes.

remedies.name: Fixed sleep routine
remedies.how: Same bed and wake time daily, no screens 1 hour before bed, dark quiet room.

remedies.name: Deep breathing / anulom-vilom
remedies.how: 10 minutes of slow breathing: in for 4 seconds, hold 4, out for 6.

remedies.name: Chamomile tea
remedies.how: A cup of chamomile tea 30 minutes before bed.

remedies.name: Amla (Indian gooseberry)
remedies.how: 1 fresh amla or 20 ml amla juice with your iron-rich meal to improve iron absorption.

remedies.name: Roasted chana with a small piece of jaggery
remedies.how: A handful of roasted chana with a small piece of gur as an iron-rich snack.

remedies.name: Morning sunlight
remedies.how: 15-20 minutes of sunlight on face and arms between 10 am and 3 pm, most days.

remedies.name: Methi (fenugreek) water
remedies.how: Soak 1 teaspoon methi seeds overnight; drink the water and chew the seeds in the morning.

remedies.name: 10-15 minute walk after meals
remedies.how: A light walk after lunch and dinner helps blood sugar, digestion and BP.

remedies.name: Hot fomentation
remedies.how: Hot water bag wrapped in a towel on the painful area for 15-20 minutes, 2-3 times a day.

default: Drink 2.5-3 litres of water a day unless a doctor limits fluids
30 minutes of walking or light exercise if you feel well
sick: Small, frequent meals if appetite is low
Keep sipping fluids through the day
